response.sql:
WITH counts_by_side AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(risk_margin_count) AS avg_count
  FROM counts_by_side
)
SELECT
  SUM(c.risk_margin_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(c.risk_margin_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess
FROM counts_by_side AS c
CROSS JOIN average_count AS a
WHERE c.risk_margin_count > a.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: Sides with no matched risk/margin records are excluded from the average because the count is computed after the requested inner join and grouped over resulting records.
